hypothesis: The live policy's all-telemetry-unavailable safety fallback was replacing a valid cold-page retrieval target with the previous anchor table, and the cache-side transfer builder could only prepare one cold page even when the selected target contained multiple cold pages.
changed_variables: safe fallback is suppressed when an authenticated retrieval result selects a host-backed cold page
live H2D transfer preparation covers every cold page in the policy target with a distinct slot and page identity
attention diagnostics publish bounded logical selected_page_ids

implementation.policy: llama_kv_live_policy_apply retains a valid host-backed cold retrieval target before applying the no-telemetry anchor fallback
implementation.promotion: llama_kv_cache::apply_pager_live_policy builds one canonical-host H2D plan per cold target page; slots are assigned from the same policy target order
implementation.safety: existing transaction epoch, page identity, host-valid, pool-slot, synchronous fence, rollback, dirty-victim, and stale-transfer checks remain authoritative
implementation.telemetry: selected logical page IDs are included in llama_kv_attention_execution_metrics and the server pager metrics receipt

local_verification.command: cmake --build build-cuda --target test-kv-attention-exact test-kv-residency test-kv-pager test-kv-routing-retrieval test-kv-routing-summary test-kv-attention-view test-kv-attention-telemetry test-cuda-fattn-paged-turbo4 -j2

deterministic_coverage.cold_promotion_and_clean_eviction: test-kv-policy replaces a clean resident victim with a host-backed cold retrieval page and commits a two-page cold promotion
deterministic_coverage.dirty_seal_and_host_valid: test-kv-pager and test-kv-residency cover sealing, host-valid eviction, dirty-victim refusal, and rollback
deterministic_coverage.stale_generation_and_cancellation: test-kv-pager, test-kv-residency, and test-kv-policy cover generation, stale completion, failed transfer, and cancellation paths
deterministic_coverage.gaps_and_tails: test-kv-attention-view, test-kv-routing-retrieval, test-kv-attention-exact, and CUDA Turbo4 fixtures cover logical gaps and tails
deterministic_coverage.selected_receipt: test-kv-attention-execution asserts the selected logical page ID receipt

live_probe.reason: The active managed GPU service owned the model allocation. After the first bounded startup attempt, the old process was auto-restarted by systemd; stopping llama-server.service requires interactive authentication, and the local binary then failed model allocation with only about 1.0-1.1 GiB free.
live_probe.health_check: The active managed service returned {"status":"ok"} with its configured API key, but its current command is a non-pager --kv-unified service, so it is not valid cold-page evidence.
